visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tricolor Corgi with a pink collar walks through lush green grass toward the camera. A human hand enters from the left, gently stroking the dog's flank as it moves. The Corgi has its mouth open, panting with its pink tongue hanging out. The background consists of a wide grassy field, tall deciduous trees, and an overcast gray sky. (2) The Corgi suddenly dives face-first into the grass and rolls onto its back. It kicks its four paws in the air repeatedly, wiggling its white and tan torso vigorously against the blades of grass. The camera moves closer to capture the dog's belly and expressive, happy face. In the distance, another dog is visible lying down further away in the field. (3) The Corgi rolls back onto its feet and starts trotting excitedly through the grass. Its ears are perked up, and its mouth remains open while panting. The camera follows the dog's quick movements as it navigates the uneven turf. The surrounding park setting remains consistent with a few large trees and a cloudy horizon. (4) The Corgi pauses and looks intently toward the right side of the frame. A human hand appears holding a green and yellow tennis ball. The dog eagerly opens its mouth and takes the ball from the hand. The scene concludes with a close-up of the dog's face as it holds the ball firmly.
